// CASE ts_inorder_canonical expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}

// CASE ts_inorder_two_awaits_in_call expect=fire
export async function inOrder2<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    log(await step(item), await audit(item));
  }
}
